judgement.reason: Mastodon's real-time UI requires a separate Node.js streaming API server running alongside the Rails web server, so it is two application services that Deployz cannot run together.

evidence.quote: **Real-time, chronological timeline updates** - updates of people you're following appear in real-time in the UI.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (web, streaming). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The production compose file runs a separate Node.js streaming service beside the Rails web process, and no shown line proves that the streaming API is optional for production.
